issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' found. Code style rule 5 explicitly prohibits this pattern: 'url = ""  # CI fills this（应由适配者填写）'. The url attribute (recipe hosting URL) is empty with a comment indicating CI will fill it, but the rule requires the adapter to fill it in. The recipe metadata is incomplete.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace the empty url with the actual recipe hosting URL. For this project, fill in the cnb.cool repository URL where the recipe is hosted, e.g., url = "https://cnb.cool/<org>/<repo>/-/tree/main/archives/m/mruby". Remove the '# CI fills this' comment.

issues.description: Status inconsistency in notes.md. Line 7 states '状态: published' (implying CI upload succeeded) but line 78 states '最终状态: built' (verified but not uploaded). These two statuses are contradictory. While this is in notes.md rather than manifest.yaml (so review_memory rule 3 about manifest.yaml doesn't directly apply), the inconsistency is misleading and should be corrected.
issues.fix_suggestion: Make the status consistent throughout notes.md. If the package is 'built' (verified but not yet uploaded to the artifact repository), change line 7 from '状态: published' to '状态: built'. The 'published' status should only be used after CI upload succeeds.

issues.description: CFLAGS="-fPIC -O2 -Wall" and AR=llvm-ar are hardcoded in both build() (lines 89-90) and package() (lines 100-101). While CC and CXX are correctly sourced from Conan conf ('tools.build:compiler_executables'), CFLAGS and AR are hardcoded and do not respect Conan's build_type (e.g., Debug builds should use -g -O0) or compiler profile settings. This is not a R33 violation (the values won't be empty on release workers since they're hardcoded, not read from bare os.environ), but the recipe could be more flexible.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider sourcing CFLAGS from Conan conf or building them dynamically based on self.settings.build_type (e.g., '-g -O0' for Debug, '-O2' for Release). For AR, consider reading from self.conf.get('tools.build:archiver') with fallback to 'llvm-ar'. This would make the recipe respect Conan profile settings.

issues.description: manifest.yaml is not present in the changed files list. Review_memory rule 17 specifies the archive directory structure should include manifest.yaml at both software level (archives/m/mruby/manifest.yaml) and version level (archives/m/mruby/3.3.0/manifest.yaml). If this is the first version of mruby being adapted, manifest.yaml should be created to record the build status (published/built/failed). Without it, the build status cannot be verified per review_memory rule 3.
issues.fix_suggestion: Create archives/m/mruby/3.3.0/manifest.yaml with the correct build status. Based on notes.md final status 'built', use: status: built. If the files already exist from a prior setup PR and were not modified, this can be ignored.

issues.description: The 交付物 (deliverables) section mentions 'mruby-3.3.0-ohos-aarch64.tar.gz | 8555KB | 预编译包 (bin + lib + include)'. While no actual binary files are included in the PR (R19 is not violated), and commands.json correctly has 'binary: false' (CI builds from source), this documentation entry could be misleading by suggesting a pre-compiled binary is a deliverable of this PR.
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify in the 交付物 section that this describes the local build output for verification purposes, not a PR deliverable. Add a note like 'CI will build from source; this entry documents the local verification build output only.'

issues.description: PREFIX={self.package_folder} in the package() method is not quoted. If the package folder path contains spaces, the rake install command would break. Code style rule 8 requires variables to be double-quoted to prevent word-splitting issues.
issues.fix_suggestion: Quote the path: change 'PREFIX={self.package_folder}' to 'PREFIX="{self.package_folder}"' in the f-string. This ensures the command works correctly even if the path contains spaces.

summary: Audit of mruby 3.3.0 Conan recipe (8 changed files) against code_style and review_memory rules. VERDICT: PASS (with warnings). No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. Key deception checks all pass: (1) R34 - test_package/test.c calls real mruby C API (mrb_open, mrb_load_string, mrb_fixnum, mrb_close) and verifies 1+2=3, not a stub; (2) sha256 in conandata.yml verified as real by downloading the actual GitHub archive and computing sha256sum (matches: 53088367e3d7657eb722ddfacb938f74aed1f8538b3717fe0b6eb8f58402af65); (3) R39 - source URL is official GitHub archive (https://github.com/mruby/mruby/archive/refs/tags/3.3.0.tar.gz); (4) No pre-compiled binaries in PR (R19); (5) No stub #ifdef __OHOS__ (R8); (6) R33 - CC/CXX sourced from Conan conf, not bare os.environ; (7) R32 - no '== Linux' platform checks; (8) R38 - commands.json exists for executables with type='tool'; (9) R37 - version 3.3.0 matches upstream; (10) Conan 2.x API used correctly. One P2 issue: url='' template placeholder in conanfile.py (should be filled by adapter). Five P3 suggestions: notes.md status inconsistency, hardcoded CFLAGS/AR, missing manifest.yaml, misleading 'precompiled' mention in notes, and unquoted PREFIX path.
